name: Kine Azusa
source:
Exclusive chef for the school cafeteria.

Methodical and thorough. She's the type of person who aims for perfection in everything and won't stop until she's achieved it. She is also a connoisseur of flavor.

Her incredibly swift knife skills and perfect time management in making multiple dishes at once have earned her the nickname [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avalokite%C5%9Bvara#Thousand-armed_Avalokite%C5%9Bvara]Thousand-armed Kannon[/url]. She earns twice as much as others, but she also handles three times the workload, so no one complains.

She's aware of the protagonist as a talented breastcarer with an excellent reputation. Even though she knows it would get in the way of her cooking, she can't help but think that, since the girls at the school all have such huge breasts, she'd like to grow her own a bit more as well.

[Translated from the [url=https://edoire.jp/products/ikunew/chr/18.html]official website[/url]]
